heading: INT. BOTANICAL CONSERVATORY - ORCHID HOUSE - MORNING

units.text: INT. BOTANICAL CONSERVATORY - ORCHID HOUSE - MORNING
A glass vault dense with steam and green.
Orchids hang from the beams like lanterns.
Droplets fall from the ceiling in a slow, steady rain.
A brick path winds between beds.
PERPETUA ODUYA, thirties, crouches at the edge of a bed with a small brass trowel and a notebook, sketching a pale-lipped orchid.
Her sleeves are rolled, her braid pinned up, and a smear of soil runs across her forehead.
She sketches the same petal over and over, erasing, as if the paper were stubborn.
A door at the far end opens.
Cool air rolls in.
A man steps inside, shaking out an umbrella, and stops, fogged by the heat.
This is CASPIAN LOVELL-HERRERA, thirties, in a tweed coat and wire spectacles that are instantly opaque with steam.
He takes them off, wipes them, and puts them on again.
Forgive me. I was told the botanist was in.
units.name: CASPIAN

units.text: You were told correctly.
units.name: PERPETUA

units.text: You are the botanist?
units.name: CASPIAN

units.text: I'm the person who waters the botanist's plants.
units.name: PERPETUA

units.text: That sounds like a botanist to me.
units.name: CASPIAN

units.text: It sounds like a gardener.
units.name: PERPETUA

units.text: My apologies.
units.name: CASPIAN

units.text: Don't apologize. I'd rather be called a gardener.
units.name: PERPETUA

units.text: She returns to her sketch.
He walks along the path, craning at the orchids, his hand hovering over a bloom without touching it.
This one is extraordinary.
units.name: CASPIAN

units.text: Don't touch it.
units.name: PERPETUA

units.text: I wasn't going to.
units.name: CASPIAN

units.text: You were thinking about it.
units.name: PERPETUA

units.text: I was thinking about it, yes.
units.name: CASPIAN

units.text: Everybody does.
units.name: PERPETUA

units.text: A bead of water falls from a beam and lands on his shoulder.
He glances up.
Another lands on his glasses, and he wipes them, laughing softly.
Do you mind if I ask what you're drawing?
units.name: CASPIAN

units.text: A Paphiopedilum. Slipper orchid. It's dying.
units.name: PERPETUA

units.text: Dying?
units.name: CASPIAN

units.text: Not the plant. The species. There are eleven left in the wild.
units.name: PERPETUA

units.text: Eleven?
units.name: CASPIAN

units.text: That we know of.
units.name: PERPETUA

units.text: Caspian takes a step closer.
He lowers himself to one knee beside her, at a respectful distance.
And you're drawing them?
units.name: CASPIAN

units.text: Somebody should remember what they looked like.
units.name: PERPETUA

units.text: That's the most beautiful thing I've heard all week.
units.name: CASPIAN

units.text: It's a Tuesday.
units.name: PERPETUA

units.text: Then it's the most beautiful thing I've heard this Tuesday.
units.name: CASPIAN

units.text: She smiles, in spite of herself, and shows him the page.
He studies it with great seriousness.
You've given it a face.
units.name: CASPIAN

units.text: They have faces. You just have to look.
units.name: PERPETUA

units.text: I'm Caspian, by the way. Caspian Lovell-Herrera. I'm with the funding committee.
units.name: CASPIAN

units.text: Oh.
units.name: PERPETUA

units.text: Is that bad?
units.name: CASPIAN

units.text: That depends on what you've come to tell me.
units.name: PERPETUA

units.text: I came to tell you we're keeping the house open.
units.name: CASPIAN

units.text: Really?
units.name: PERPETUA

units.text: Really.
units.name: CASPIAN

units.text: She lowers her notebook to the brick and looks up into the green, where the water keeps falling, and for a moment says nothing at all.
He waits, hat in his hand, steam fogging his glasses again.
Then you may touch it. Once.
units.name: PERPETUA

units.text: Once?
units.name: CASPIAN

units.text: Gently.
units.name: PERPETUA

units.text: He reaches out one finger and rests it on the petal's edge.
It trembles and holds.
